mapper.sql: SELECT f.*, f.return_1y AS return1y, f.is_pool_eligible AS pool_eligible, (fav.id IS NOT NULL) AS favorite, n.per_10k_income AS per10k_income, n.annualized_7d AS annualized7d FROM fund f LEFT JOIN favorite fav ON fav.fund_id=f.id AND fav.user_id=#{userId} LEFT JOIN fund_nav n ON n.fund_id=f.id AND n.nav_date=f.latest_nav_date AND n.deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000' WHERE f.deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000'

select.if: AND fav.id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fav.created_at DESC, fav.id DESC
